title: Will anyone solve the Hartwell Building mystery on VidTube?
body:
Resolves YES if a VidTube video definitively explains what happened at the Hartwell Building in 2018, with evidence that is widely accepted as credible.

"Widely accepted" = more than 70% positive reception and no successful debunking.

Midnight Mystery Files has been investigating but no conclusive evidence yet.
summary: Whether a VidTube video will definitively solve the Hartwell Building 2018 mystery with credible evidence.

comments.content: MMF is getting close. Their last video had some really compelling evidence.
There's nothing to solve. It was a gas leak. This will never resolve YES.
